body.p: About Tas Once Tas went hunting in a boat and thought: "Oh, I want to eat." He landed on the shore. Then he kindled the fire. Around the fire, he stuck pahe (dried boneless fish). He sits down near the fire. He looks at the pahe. Suddenly he hears someone coming. He lifted his head, what is there? He got scared. The bear goes straight for him, approached him. Tas got even more scared. He has no strength to rise. When he looked at him, the bear looked like this. The great one stood up on his hind legs and showed his mouth with his paw. Then he extended his paw to the lake. As if pointing to something. From this place in the other direction he turned and went. Tas has lost all desire to eat. The fire went out. He went to the boat. He sits in the boat. Suddenly he looks: where the bear pointed, on small islands, seagulls are nodding. He thought, "Why don't I go take a look." Here he looks, in the place that the bear pointed out, the calf walks, croaks, runs away from the seagulls. Tas took this calf with him. This calf was a female reindeer. From this calf, Tas became rich. Until now, his descendants live, live well. And the lake was called Animal Lake. Now it is called Lake Chil on the maps.
